description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center. This pivotal role offers the opportunity to oversee all aspects of facility management, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency. You will be instrumental in fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff.

The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership skills and a commitment to excellence in long-term care. This is a chance to make a significant impact within a supportive and dynamic organization, contributing to the well-being of residents and the success of the facility. We offer a competitive salary for this critical leadership position.
requirements: Active Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven leadership experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations for long-term care
Demonstrated ability to manage operations, finances, and staff effectively
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, based on experience.
